name: Unidentified green-plated ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified green-plated ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid
description: An ST-series super tactical droid was a member of a Separatist crew that operated on the planet Loradil during the New Republic Era after their Providence-class carrier was shot down. Around 6 ABY, the super tactical droid encountered the humans Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, Beilert Valance and Rynn Zenat on the planet and fought them, but was eventually destroyed by Valance.
